risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantitative detail, including customer concentration, reserves, sales growth, debt, liquidity, and forward guidance. Key risks include extreme customer concentration, dependence on COVID-related demand, supply-chain and labor constraints, intellectual-property litigation, and uncertainty around the recoverability of former-customer balances. Management maintains a cautiously positive outlook, but several forecasts rely on assumptions and contain broad uncertainty disclaimers.
